core_obligations: Unwind representability by algebraic spaces: fix a scheme Z over S with a morphism Z -> Y and reduce the claim to showing that X x_Y Z is an algebraic space (proof lines 2733-2735).
Choose a scheme U with a surjective etale morphism U -> X, which exists because X is an algebraic space over S (proof line 2736).
Show that the base change U x_Y Z -> X x_Y Z remains representable, surjective and etale (proof lines 2737-2739).
Show that U x_Y Z is a scheme, using the diagonal lemma for formal algebraic spaces (proof lines 2740-2741).
Conclude that X x_Y Z is an algebraic space by the bootstrap theorem, hence that f is representable by algebraic spaces (proof lines 2742-2744).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a scheme-valued test object Z -> Y and to the requirement that X x_Y Z be an algebraic space (proof lines 2733-2735).
Take an etale scheme cover U -> X of the algebraic space X and base change it along Z -> Y (proof lines 2736-2739).
Recognise U x_Y Z as a scheme via the diagonal of a formal algebraic space (proof lines 2740-2741).
Apply the bootstrap theorem to conclude (proof lines 2742-2743).
difficulty_reason: The statement is that any morphism from an algebraic space over S to a formal algebraic space over S is representable by algebraic spaces (statement lines 2726-2731). The proof is short but completely displayed: a scheme-valued test object Z -> Y is fixed, representability is unwound to the single requirement that X x_Y Z be an algebraic space (proof lines 2733-2735), a scheme U with a surjective etale map U -> X is chosen (proof lines 2736-2736), and then two inputs are combined -- the base change U x_Y Z -> X x_Y Z of that covering is again representable surjective etale (proof lines 2737-2739), and U x_Y Z is a scheme by the diagonal lemma of the chapter (proof lines 2740-2741) -- after which the final bootstrap theorem upgrades the etale covering by an algebraic space to the conclusion that X x_Y Z is an algebraic space (proof lines 2742-2743). Every step of the reduction is present and the conclusion is reached; the level is H2 because the work consists in setting up the correct reduction and applying two external results, not in producing a new construction.
